description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Sakashima's Student enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Sakashima's Student leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima's Student from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
